The algorithm originally submitted to NIST as **Dilithium** (formally known as **CRYSTALS-Dilithium**) has been standardized as **ML-DSA** (Module-Lattice-Based Digital Signature Algorithm).

This standardization was finalized under **FIPS 204**, published by NIST in August 2024. While the submission name "Dilithium" was retained for the algorithm's identity, the official designation within the standard is ML-DSA. It is important to note that the specific variant selected for standardization was "Dilithium II," as the earlier "Dilithium I" was deemed less secure.

*   **crypto_analyst**: Confirmed the transition from the submission name "Dilithium" to the standardized name ML-DSA under FIPS 204, noting the distinction between Dilithium II (selected) and Dilithium I.
*   **standards_specialist**: Verified the standard name (FIPS 204), the algorithm designation (ML-DSA), and the explicit reference to "CRYSTALS-DILITHIUM" in Appendix D of the standard.
